title: Institutional knowledge retrieval
scope: Index reviewed case reasoning, accepted alternatives and legal authority versions under case permissions

acceptance.text: Index reviewed case reasoning, accepted alternatives and legal authority versions under case permissions
Retrieve relevant authorized cases with citations and clearly distinguish institutional memory from binding precedent
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Retrieve relevant authorized cases with citations and clearly distinguish institutional memory from binding precedent

evidence.text: ai/workflows/institutional_knowledge.py build_index keeps only independently reviewed outcomes (TAX-046 decisions status approved, reviewer_role supervisor, reviewer != proposer) with officer reasoning, accepted alternatives (with EvidenceRefs), cited EvidenceRefs (SHA-256 + page/record locator) and legal authority versions recorded at decision time; drafts/proposed/self-reviewed decisions are counted as skipped, never indexed. Retrieval is case-permission scoped: TAX-053 check_read_access before any record is read, then a required deny-by-default can_read_case per case (exceptions and non-True deny), restricted records supervisor-only, active case excluded, taxpayer/reviewer identifiers omitted.

tests/ai/test_institutional_knowledge.py (9 tests): officer gets only the authorised, cited prior case (k1) with its EvidenceRef and accepted alternative; other-team, restricted and active cases withheld (withheld_by_permission 2) while a supervisor with full permission sees all three; unauthenticated/other-tenant/taxpayer callers refused before the permission callback runs; failing or non-True permission checks return nothing and a missing check is refused. Every result and response is nature institutional_memory, binding false, with a notice that it is not binding precedent or legal authority; cited authority SYN-PLACEHOLDER-AUTH-001@2024.1 reported no_longer_in_force with 2025.1 in force now, AUTH-002 unverified, unknown authority flagged. Instruction-like reasoning flagged not obeyed; deterministic ranking; invalid records fail closed. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 204 passed; ruff/mypy (188 files) pass.

Tests and evidence recorded on task/TAX-068 (criteria 1-2). Branch current with main, pushed explicitly; human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/193 opened with checks, limitations and Windows-only environment exceptions documented. Agent will not merge.

notes.text: Agent finished implementation and opened human review. task.py finish steps run individually: its dev.py check/quality.py gate fails on this Windows checkout only (POSIX file-mode tooling tests; CRLF vs Prettier), documented in the PR.
